How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: very confusing and took time to register

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: you had to find subjects that didn't overlap (which was difficult), then they had to be approved in several places before you could be registered for the subject - I had a very confusing experience with it

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: you could write to the teachers, but otherwise none

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: had to take subjects I didn't originally want so they didn't overlap

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Check when the courses are available from home, and check for more courses if the ones you originally wanted are not created.
